run_body_pose_detection: run the Body class on an image to detect human body keypoints and poses
create_body_model: create a Body instance by loading a pretrained body pose model from a model path file
move_body_model_to_device: move the Body model to a specified device like cuda or cpu for inference
format_body_result: format raw candidate and subset arrays into a list of BodyResult objects with keypoints
review_bodypose_model: review the Body class and bodypose_model integration for open pose human keypoint detection
